The Qur'an and its sciences

Works on the Qur'an

526 works by 77 authors in 10 languages, shown five ways. Archived 24 October 2026.

Everything in the archive filed under Qur'anic studies: commentaries and translations, studies of the Qur'an's language and structure, its history and compilation, and essays and lectures on its meaning. 216 of the 526 can be read here in full; the rest link to a free copy elsewhere. The commentaries and translations on their own are on the Tafseer page.

  • Library: search, filter by language and type, with the archived date and citation for each work.
  • By author: each writer with his or her works, oldest first.
  • Timeline: the works by year of publication.
  • By language: the works grouped by language.
  • Table: everything in one list that you can search and sort.

The library view: search, filter by language and type, and sort. Each entry shows when it was archived and how to cite it.

BOOK 1880 · Urdu
Tafsir al-Qur'an تفسیر القرآن وھو الھدیٰ والفرقان Sayyid Ahmad Khan

His rationalist commentary on the Qur'an, published in seven volumes between 1880 and 1904 and left incomplete, which interprets miracles and the unseen in harmony with natural law.

Archived 14 October 2026 in Islamic Internet Archives: Archive of Modern Islamic Thought. https://islamicarchives.org/authors/sayyid-ahmad-khan/#sayyid-ahmad-khan-tafsir-al-quran
